annotations.title: Historical Calldata, Revert & Failed Tx Decoder (Free)

description: Decode existing hex calldata, custom Solidity revert bytes, or a mined transaction hash to explain historical failures and flag malicious approvals. Use this AFTER a transaction failed or when auditing opaque 0x calldata bytes before signing (100 free calls/day/IP). Returns decoded 4-byte function signature, argument breakdown, revert reason, and approval-drainer warnings. Do NOT use to dry-run an unsigned transaction against live chain state (use nullclear_simulate_transaction instead).

input.description: 0x-prefixed raw hex calldata/revert bytes OR a 66-character mined transaction hash to replay

name: nullclear_decode_calldata
